🏷️ Alexrims TD26 26" Front Wheel w/ Schwalbe Tire & Rotor
📦 Item ID: #WF04
💰 Price: 200 DKK

📝 Description:
Solid 26" mountain bike front wheel featuring an Alexrims TD26 XD 2500 double-wall disc rim laced to a standard 9x100mm quick-release hub. Includes a Tektro 160 mm 6-bolt disc rotor, QR skewer, reflector, and a Schwalbe Black Jack 26x2.00" tire with healthy tread. Some minor cosmetic wear and slight surface corrosion on bolts/skewer, but spins freely and is ready to ride.

• Brake Type: 6-Bolt Disc (Tektro 160 mm rotor included)
• Tire: Schwalbe Black Jack 26x2.00 (50-559)
• Valve: Presta

🚴 Ready to inspect and pick up in Copenhagen. No shipping – personal pickup only in 2300 Copenhagen S. MobilePay accepted.
